name: miyagi
description: A voice tutor for codebases: ask out loud, and it explains while highlighting the code it talks about.
author: Sarthak Kumar

scripts.check: biome check . && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && svelte-check --tsconfig tsconfig.web.json --fail-on-warnings && knip && vitest run --passWithNoTests
scripts.check:fast: biome lint . && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && svelte-check --tsconfig tsconfig.web.json --fail-on-warnings
